page.notes: Doubtful readings: "su-" in "securè su-merem" is read as su- (sumerem), the scan looks like fu- at the line end. The marginal note "Bulluæs." is uncertain; the printed form may differ. Long s is written as plain s. The ff/ss ligature in "respondisse" and "posset" is rendered as ss. The last word "qui" is a catchword and not part of the text.
